description: Phishing scams use fake emails, messages or websites that appear to come from trusted organizations. The goal is often to steal login credentials or personal information.
warning_signs: Messages pretending to be from trusted organizations
safety: Do not click suspicious links
Verify the sender
Open the official website directly instead of using the message link
Never share passwords or OTPs

description: UPI related scams can involve fake payment requests, cashback offers, QR codes or social engineering intended to trick users into transferring money or revealing sensitive information.
warning_signs: Requests for UPI PIN or OTP
safety: Verify the recipient before making a payment
Never share your UPI PIN
Do not approve unknown payment requests
Be careful with unexpected cashback or reward messages

description: Digital arrest scams involve criminals pretending to be law enforcement or government officials and threatening victims with arrest or legal consequences unless money is transferred.
warning_signs: Video calls claiming to be investigations
safety: Do not panic
Do not transfer money because of threats
Verify the person's identity independently
Do not share sensitive personal or financial information

description: Scammers may pretend to be customer support representatives and ask users to reveal sensitive information or install applications that can provide remote access to their devices.
warning_signs: Requests for OTP or UPI PIN
safety: Use contact information from the official company website
Do not install unknown applications
Never share OTPs or UPI PINs
Do not give remote access to strangers

description: In this scam, a fraudster claims that money was accidentally transferred to the victim and pressures the victim to return the money quickly. Fake transaction receipts may be used to make the claim appear genuine.
warning_signs: Unexpected claim of a money transfer
Requests to transfer money to another account
safety: Verify the transaction independently
Do not rely only on screenshots
Do not transfer money under pressure
Contact your bank through official channels

description: Scammers may send fake cashback or reward messages containing links or QR codes and attempt to trick users into making a payment or sharing sensitive information.
safety: Do not trust unexpected reward messages
Do not enter your UPI PIN to receive money
Verify offers through official applications
Avoid suspicious links and QR codes
